event_created.name: Fergusson Fest 2026
event_created.audience: 18-22 year old arts, science and commerce students; many live in nearby PGs and hostels

demo-bean-theory.body:
Hi Bean Theory Team,

Fergusson Fest 2026 is taking place on December 12, bringing together 1,800+ students right down the street from your cafe on FC Road. Most of our attendees live in nearby PGs and hostels looking for their regular study and coffee hangout.

We have tailored a partnership package that gives Bean Theory direct exposure, from coupon drops in 500 welcome kits to on-campus kiosk space and social promotions, with packages starting at ₹8,000.

Our full proposal is attached with tier details. Could we set up a quick 5-minute call this week to explore partnering up?

Warm regards,
Fergusson Fest Team
demo-bean-theory.subject: Partnership Proposal: Bean Theory Cafe x Fergusson Fest 2026

demo-pulsefit-gym.body: Hi Team PulseFit, Fergusson Fest 2026 is bringing together over 1,800 students on December 12th at Fergusson College, right along FC Road. Many of our attendees reside in nearby student hostels and PGs and actively seek local fitness memberships. We would love to partner with PulseFit to drive student sign-ups through on-ground promotional booth space, fitness challenge sponsorships, and flyer distribution in welcome kits. Packages start from ₹7,000, and the complete proposal is attached for your review. Would you be open to a quick 5-minute conversation or visit this week to discuss? Warm regards, Fergusson Fest Organizing Team.
demo-pulsefit-gym.subject: Fergusson Fest 2026 x PulseFit Gym Partnership

demo-apex-coaching.body:
Hi Apex Coaching Team,

With over 1,800 undergraduate arts, science, and commerce students gathering for Fergusson Fest 2026 on December 12, many are actively planning their CAT, GRE, and competitive exam preparation.

We would love to feature Apex Coaching as an education partner. We have designed actionable, lead-focused opportunities including dedicated counseling desks, brochure distribution, and stage address slots starting from ₹5,000.

Please find the attached sponsorship overview detailing our tiers and deliverables. Would you be open to connecting briefly this week to discuss how we can assist your upcoming batch admissions?

Warm regards,
Fergusson Fest Team
demo-apex-coaching.subject: Direct Student Engagement at Fergusson Fest 2026 - Apex Coaching

demo-chai-junction.body:
Hi Chai Junction Team,

I'm reaching out from the Fergusson Fest 2026 organizing team. Being just 300 meters from campus, your cafe is already a daily favorite for our hostel and PG students.

On December 12, our annual fest will host over 1,800 students. We'd love to partner with Chai Junction to drive sustained footfall and repeat visits to your cafe through exclusive campus couponing, on-ground presence, and targeted student shoutouts.

I have attached our brief sponsorship proposal outlining three flexible options starting from ₹8,000. Take a look and let us know if you'd be open to a quick 5-minute chat this week.

Warm regards,
Fergusson Fest Team
demo-chai-junction.subject: Fergusson Fest 2026 x Chai Junction Cafe Partnership
